title: Social coordination perpetuates stereotypic expectations and behaviors across generations in deep multi-agent reinforcement learning
reasoning: The study investigates the emergence and persistence of stereotypes, which it identifies as a moral concern. It evaluates human participants using specific moral and social orientation scales, including the System Justification Scale (SJS) and the Basic Social Justice Orientation scale (BSJO), to determine if these moral frameworks correlate with stereotypic behavior in social coordination tasks.
